reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: actively-learned MTPs can capture complex liquid configurations better than EAM, improving phase-space overlap and reducing TI errors, though the quantitative claims (40–50% reduction) are speculative without evidence.
reasons.testability: The test is clear and decisive: compare TI free energies from MTP vs. EAM references against ab initio benchmarks, with falsification criteria (error reduction <30–40% or deviation >10–20 meV/atom), but the ab initio benchmark for liquid HEA is extremely challenging and may be impractical.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the core problem of reference–target overlap in liquid HEA free-energy calculations and proposes a concrete, modern solution that would be valuable to researchers in the field.
